subject.title: Control UI: replace sidebar More section with an overflow menu

question: Should the Control UI permanently replace the expandable More section with the transient overflow-menu interaction proposed by the linked PR?
rationale: This changes a primary navigation interaction and removes a persisted UI preference, so final acceptance requires maintainer UX direction even though the implementation is already proposed.

options.title: Sponsor the overflow menu
options.body: Approve the interaction direction and review the linked PR’s accessibility, responsive behavior, plugin-route coverage, and preference removal before merge.

options.title: Retain expandable More
options.body: Keep the current navigation interaction and close the linked PR if persistent expansion and direct route visibility are preferred.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the overflow menu
recommendation.body: Approve the interaction direction and review the linked PR’s accessibility, responsive behavior, plugin-route coverage, and preference removal before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The paired proposal and recent adjacent Control UI product work make steipete the strongest available owner for this UX decision.
